Overview.title: Overview
Overview.subtitle: Project {project}
Overview.connectText: Adelie collects analytics from your social accounts every day. Pinterest comes first — Instagram and TikTok are next.
Overview.reauthBanner: {count, plural, one {# account needs} other {# accounts need}} to be reconnected
Overview.deltaHint: Change vs the previous period of the same length
Overview.preliminaryHint: Includes recent days that the platform is still finalizing — the number may change slightly.

chart.title: Impressions by day
chart.hint: Dashed: days the platform is still finalizing. Gaps: days without data — not zero.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Snapshots to share with clients
reports.text: Build a report for a period and share it by a secret link — no sign-in needed for the reader.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Project, team and workspace
settings.text: Project timezone and currency, team members and their access will be managed here.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.subtitle: How colleagues in your workspaces see and reach you

hints.contactEmail: For colleagues; can differ from your sign-in email
hints.loginEmail: Used to sign in. Changing it is not available yet.

errors.invalidImage: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image

Accounts.title: Accounts
Accounts.subtitle: Social accounts connected to this project
Accounts.collectingHint: Adelie collects data daily from the moment of connection; the platform also returns up to 90 days of history.
Accounts.noPermission: Only the owner, an admin or a manager can connect accounts.

result.connected: Pinterest connected. Data will appear after the first sync.
result.denied: Connection cancelled — access was not granted in Pinterest.
result.expired: The connection link has expired. Please try again.
result.alreadyConnected: This Pinterest account is already connected to another project in this workspace.
result.error: Could not connect the account. Please try again later.

Accounts.anotherAccountHint: Pinterest connects the account you are signed in to in this browser. To add another one, switch to it on pinterest.com first, then press Connect.

sync.personal: Personal account: boards and pins are not available.
sync.personalHint: Pinterest shares pins and boards only of business accounts with apps. Switching to a free business account in Pinterest settings unlocks them; profile and account analytics already work.
sync.partial: Part of the data was not available during the last sync.
sync.failed: The last sync failed. Adelie will retry within an hour.
sync.partialHint: Some steps were skipped because the platform did not allow them; everything else is up to date. Adelie tries again with the next sync.
sync.failedHint: Adelie could not reach the platform. It will retry automatically within an hour; nothing needs to be done.

Accounts.emptyText: Connect a social account with the button in the top-right corner — Adelie starts collecting its data right away.
Accounts.inviteCopied: Invitation link copied — valid for 7 days, single use.
Accounts.invitationsHint: Send the link to whoever owns the account — a client, or yourself in another browser. They connect it without an Adelie account; the link works once and expires in 7 days.
Accounts.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {name}?
disconnectDialog.text: Adelie deletes the access tokens right away and stops syncing. The data collected so far stays — connect the same account again later and its history continues without a gap.
disconnectDialog.platformHint: To also remove Adelie from the account's connected apps, do it in Pinterest: Settings → Connected apps.

removeDialog.title: Delete {name} with all data?
removeDialog.text: The account, its pins, boards, metrics and sync history are deleted permanently. History older than 90 days cannot be fetched from the platform again.

Invite.title: Connect {platform} to Adelie
Invite.lead: {name} from {workspace} invites you to connect your account so they can see its analytics.
Invite.leadNoName: {workspace} invites you to connect your account so they can see its analytics.
Invite.explain: You will sign in on {platform} and confirm access there. Adelie can only read profile, boards, pins and their statistics — it cannot post, edit or delete anything. Access can be revoked at any time in your {platform} settings.
Invite.startFailed: Could not start the connection. Please try again.

unavailable.missing: The invitation was not found. Ask whoever sent it for a new link.
unavailable.expired: The invitation has expired. Ask whoever sent it for a new link.
unavailable.used: This invitation has already been used.
unavailable.revoked: The invitation was cancelled by whoever sent it.

connected.title: Account connected
connected.text: Thank you! Your account is connected; you can close this page.

denied.title: Connection cancelled
denied.text: Access was not granted. You can open the invitation link again whenever you are ready.

expired.title: The link is no longer valid
expired.text: The invitation expired or was used. Ask whoever sent it for a new link.

alreadyConnected.title: Already connected
alreadyConnected.text: This account is already connected to another project of the same workspace.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The account could not be connected. Please try again a bit later.

Content.title: Content
Content.lifetimeHint: Pin metrics are lifetime totals reported by Pinterest, updated daily. “—” means Pinterest has no data for that pin (for example, older pins), not zero.
Content.emptyText: Pins appear here after the first sync of a business account. Personal Pinterest accounts don't share pins with apps.
